summary.text: Edward Ra is a Republican member of the New York State Assembly representing District 19, an office he has held since 2013, and is seeking re-election on the Republican and Conservative Party lines in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is an attorney and began serving as Minority Leader in 2026.

paragraphs.text: Ra earned a B.A. from Loyola College in Maryland in 2004, a J.D. from St. John's University School of Law in 2007, and an LL.M. in Intellectual Property Law from the Benjamin N. Cardozo School of Law in 2008.
His professional experience includes serving as a legal aide to the New York State Attorney General and as Deputy Town Attorney for the Town of Hempstead.
For the 2025-2026 session, Ra was assigned to the Rules and Ways and Means committees.
